answer: Prayers & Duties >> Zakat & Charity Question ID: 8173 Country: Pakistan Title: Is the Zakat applicable on precious stone/diamond? Question: Is the Zakat applicable on precious stone/diamond? Thanks Answer ID: 8173 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1053/1053=M/1429) There is no Zakah on precious stones and diamond. Yes, if they are for business purpose then the Zakah shall be wajib (necessary): لا زکاۃ فی اللآلی والجواھر الا ان تکون للتجارۃ۔ Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
